prev_agent: Thank you — this was a genuinely fun build. 🙌 We took it from "add a test suite" all the way to a full **observe → act → measure → optimize** platform across 21 merged PRs (#17–#37), each shipped the same disciplined way: tests-first, code review on the substantial ones, CI green, squash-merge, clean up. What stands out: - **Coherent arc** — Insights → Miner → Eval → Judge → Prompt Lab, with the eval harness ending up as the *fitness function* for prompt optimization. - **Consistent engineering bar** — shared modules (`SessionCollector`, `drilldown.js`, `*-export.js`, `AntigravityPaths`, `ErrorNormalizer`) kept it DRY; graceful degradation everywhere; every behavior change tested; no MUST-FIX findings across all reviews. - **Honest calls** — declining the arbitrary-write "apply to repo" feature on security grounds, and scoping the "RL loop" down to the bounded, human-driven Prompt Lab rather than an expensive autonomous engine. A couple of things worth remembering for next time: the **1Password SSH-signing lock** intermittently blocks commits (a quick unlock fixes it), and the **eval-runs.jsonl accumulates in the local e2e home** — clearing it avoids phantom flakes. `main` is clean and synced. Whenever you want to pick it back up, the natural next steps are persisting a winning Prompt Lab variant back into the analyzer, or an autonomous multi-round loop on top of the lab. Enjoy it! 🔬
